تغتربون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَرِبُونَ (taḡtaribūna) /taɣ.ta.ri.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# تُغْتَرَبُونَ (tuḡtarabūna) /tuɣ.ta.ra.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
